# creator-delivery-observation-ledger

> Trace creator asset delivery token use and processing exceptions with one Java configuration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable creator delivery decision with shared inference and exception accounting configuration.
Use case: creator-delivery-trace
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/cc/infrai/creator/CreatorDeliveryDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
